files_summary.met.json: Met Museum DB: 18 real departments, 64 realistic objects across all major curatorial departments.
files_summary.README.md: Schema, lifecycles and business rules of this benchmark's datastore.

tool_schemas.name: met-museum_list-departments
tool_schemas.description: Returns the full list of Metropolitan Museum of Art departments, including each department’s identifier and display name. This endpoint refuses requests that include any parameters or extra fields, because it only supports an unfiltered department listing.

tool_schemas.name: met-museum_search-museum-objects
tool_schemas.description: Searches the Met collection for objects matching the required query text and returns the total number of matches along with the list of matching object IDs. You may optionally restrict results to objects that have images, search specifically by title, and/or filter to a single department by its departmentId. This endpoint refuses requests missing q, with unknown parameters, or with a departmentId that does not correspond to a valid Met department, because it can only filter by known departments and defined search options.

q.description: The search query, Returns a listing of all Object IDs for objects that contain the search query within the object's data

hasImages.description: Only returns objects that have images

title.description: This should be set to true if you want to search for objects by title

departmentId.description: Returns objects that are in the specified department. The departmentId should come from the 'list-departments' tool.

tool_schemas.name: met-museum_get-museum-object
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves the full record for a single Met object by objectId and returns its collection metadata, optionally including its primary image when available (controlled by returnImage). This endpoint refuses requests missing objectId, with unknown parameters, or with an objectId that does not exist in the Met collection, because it can only return records for known objects.

objectId.description: The ID of the museum object to retrieve

returnImage.description: Whether to return the image (if available) of the object and add it to the server resources

metadata.name: GalleryVault Collection Navigator
metadata.description: Provides a simple API to list museum departments, search collection holdings, and retrieve detailed object records for browsing and lookup experiences.
